characters.name: Ash-Lad
characters.description: The youngest son, mocked for idleness, who keeps pace with the colts, discovers their enchantment, and answers the king’s riddle truthfully in a clever way.
characters.look: A sturdy, broad-shouldered young man of about eighteen with full, round, sun-browned cheeks, a short straight nose, calm green eyes, a steady, determined smile and thick sandy-brown hair tied at the back of his neck with a leather cord. He wears a patched rust-orange wool jacket with bone buttons over an undyed linen shirt, dark-green knee breeches, grey wool stockings, sturdy black leather boots and a small brown leather knapsack on his back.

characters.name: The King
characters.description: A stern ruler who wagers his daughter and half his kingdom against a brutal punishment to test those who herd his seven colts.
characters.look: A lean, severe king of about sixty, tall and straight-backed, with a long, bony face, stern frown lines, sharp, narrow hazel eyes under bushy black eyebrows and a short, neatly trimmed grey beard. He wears a long dark-red wool robe with a grey fur collar, a thick gold chain across his chest, a small, spiky gold crown and pointed black shoes.

characters.name: The Spinning Hag
characters.description: A deceitful old woman in the mountain cleft who lures the first two brothers into laziness and tries to stop Ash-Lad.
characters.look: A tiny, hunched old woman no taller than a ten-year-old child, with a small, wrinkled face, a very long, pointed nose that nearly touches her chin, little twinkling black eyes, a sweet, sly smile and wisps of white hair. She is wrapped in many layered shawls of faded blue, brown, plum and grey over a long dark skirt, wears worn felt slippers and always holds a distaff wound with grey wool.

characters.name: The Youngest Colt (Enchanted Prince)
characters.description: The speaking colt who aids Ash-Lad, leads him to the hidden stump-door and church, and reveals how to break the spell on the seven brothers.
characters.look: A small, slender chestnut colt, the youngest and smallest of seven, with long, knobbly legs, a glossy red-brown coat, a short flaxen mane that stands up like a brush, a long flaxen tail, soft pointed ears, big dark, clever eyes with long lashes and a neat white star on his forehead.

characters.name: The Youngest Prince
characters.description: The youngest colt as he truly is: the youngest of the seven king's sons and the princess's little brother.
characters.look: A slight boy prince of about twelve, the youngest of seven brothers, with a round, freckled face, big dark eyes, a huge beaming smile and tousled strawberry-blonde hair. He wears shining white-and-gold clothes: a white tunic embroidered with gold, with a small white star on the chest, a short white cloak with gold trim, white hose and soft white leather boots.

characters.name: The Princess
characters.description: The king’s daughter, promised as the prize for the successful herdsman and sister to the seven enchanted princes.
characters.look: A cheerful princess of about nineteen with a round, freckled face, warm brown eyes, a wide, happy smile and a mass of bouncy strawberry-blonde curls falling past her shoulders, crowned with a small gold circlet set with one green stone. She wears a long pale-green wool gown with a white linen collar and cuffs, a gold-embroidered belt and soft green shoes.

characters.name: The Eldest Brother
characters.description: Ash-Lad's eldest brother, who sets out to find work but idles the whole day away with his head in the hag's lap.
characters.look: A tall, gawky young man of about twenty-two with a long, bony face, a big chin, heavy-lidded eyes, a long nose, a lazy, lopsided grin and thick, wavy dark-blond hair that sticks up at the back. He wears a red-and-white checked homespun shirt with rolled sleeves, baggy brown breeches held up by a single strap and a wide, frayed straw hat, and he goes barefoot.

places.name: the Royal Farm
places.look: A grand old royal farm of ox-blood-red log buildings with white window frames, turf roofs and carved dragon-head gables around a wide, sandy yard. The main hall has broad wooden front steps with carved railings up to a big double door. Across the yard stands a long red log stable with a wide door, and a split-rail paddock fence runs along the birch trees, with violet mountains far behind.

places.name: the Grey Cleft
